item.title: Digital infra’s 300,000-worker gap: Veterans could fill it, report finds
item.summary: The digital infrastructure industry was short of 300,000 workers in 2025. Uptime Institute's 2025 Global Data Center Survey found nearly two-thirds of operators are struggling to find qualified candidates, retain staff, or both. The post Digital infra’s 300,000-worker gap: Veterans could fill it, report finds appeared first on Capacity .
